snippet.title: ENDLESS Legend 2 - Gameplay Trailer | Turn-Based Fantasy Strategy
snippet.description:
Explore a universe of endless possibilities in ENDLESS Legend 2! 

Build your Empire across the evolving world of Saiadha as the tide falls to reveal new lands, new secrets, and, of course - new enemies and potential allies alike. 

ENDLESS Legend 2 is launching into early access Summer 2025.
